overview: The Medford City Council approved a budget amendment for contracted legal services following extended debate regarding council representation, alongside resolutions on financial reporting, veteran tax relief, and COVID-19 response measures.

items.title: Common Victualler Licenses
items.summary: Approved common victualler license petitions for Sunrise Cuisine Incorporated and Pinky's Famous Pizza.

items.title: FY22 Legal Services Budget Amendment
items.summary: Approved a $55,000 budget amendment for contracted legal services following debate over Council access to independent legal counsel versus representation through KP Law.

items.title: Quarterly Financial Health and ARPA Reports
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting quarterly presentations from the Chief Financial Officer on the city's financial health, revenue forecasts, and ARPA spending.

items.title: Monthly Warrant Articles Provision
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the Chief Financial Officer provide the Council with monthly copies of city warrant articles.

items.title: Veteran Property Tax Workoff Program
items.summary: Approved a resolution inviting the City Solicitor and City Assessor to detail the process for adopting a property tax reduction program for veterans in exchange for volunteer services.

items.title: Route 16 Debris Cleanup
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking state agencies and the legislative delegation to clean rubbish along Route 16 from the Meadow Glen Mall to the Condon Shell.

items.title: Community Engagement and Inclusion Update
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting an update from the administration on plans to strengthen community engagement and inclusion with underrepresented groups following an improper Hanukkah menorah display.

items.title: COVID-19 Response in Senior Facilities and Nursing Homes
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requesting a written report and public posting on COVID-19 response plans for local senior living facilities and nursing homes.

items.title: KN95 Mask Acquisition and Distribution
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the city acquire NIOSH-approved KN95 masks for municipal workers, high-risk individuals, and lower-income residents.

items.title: Equitable COVID-19 Surge Response Plan
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking the administration for an update on equitable COVID-19 response plans and requesting expanded testing and vaccination in disproportionately impacted neighborhoods.

items.title: Eliot-Pearson School Anniversary Recognition and Minutes
items.summary: Approved a resolution congratulating the Eliot-Pearson Children's School on its 100th anniversary and approved the meeting records from January 4, 2022.
